title.value: A Neurodynamic Model of Inter-Brain Coupling in the Gamma Band
title.justification: The title clearly states that the paper focuses on a neurodynamic model related to inter-brain coupling in the gamma band.
title.quote: A Neurodynamic Model of Inter-Brain Coupling in the Gamma Band

extractions.description: This paper presents a neurodynamic model for understanding inter-brain coupling in the gamma frequency band using a Kuramoto model. The focus is on explaining the phenomenon observed in EEG hyperscanning studies where people show neural synchronization or coupling during social interactions, particularly in the gamma frequency range.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper's central theme is neuroscience, specifically the modeling of inter-brain coupling in the gamma band, and does not directly address climate or ecological sustainability.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: This paper provides a biophysical explanation for the emergence of Gamma inter-brain coupling using a Kuramoto model of four oscillators divided into two separate (brain) units.

primary_category.justification: The paper does not address any climate or ecologically-related sustainable development themes; its focus is on neuroscience.
primary_category.quote: The use of EEG to simultaneously record multiple brains (i.e., hyperscanning) during social interactions has led to the discovery of inter-brain coupling (IBC).

primary_sub_category.justification: There is no sub-category within the climate or ecological sustainable development areas that fits the scope of this paper.
primary_sub_category.quote: Gamma oscillations' fast and transient nature makes a direct link between Gamma-IBC and other (much slower) interpersonal dynamics difficult...

new_primary_category.justification: The paper is focused on neuroscience and does not introduce new categories related to climate or ecological sustainability.
new_primary_category.quote: Interestingly, empirical EEG-hyperscanning results also report the emergence of IBC in the Gamma range [>30 Hz].

new_primary_sub_category.justification: There are no new sub-categories introduced as the paper does not address sustainable development themes.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: We provide a theoretical explanation of the observed Gamma-IBC phenomenon in the EEG-hyperscanning literature.
